title: Ramp
text: Generate constantly increasing or decreasing signal, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Slope} sets Slope of signal; {Start time} sets the time output begins, {Initial output} sets the initial value of output signal and {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} treats vectors as 1-D. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Slope
params.values: Slope of signal 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Initial value of output signal 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix
